ops_per_sample: ~140 flops: 3 Hermite reads (~60), 3 sinPar (~36), pan/sum (~12), fb write, HP + LP on 2 channels (~16), gain/mix ramps (~10). Mono-in = stereo-in cost.
notes: Mono delay ring (stereo in summed for the wet path), 3 taps at 0.8/1.0/1.2 x DELAY ms, phases 0/120/240 deg, depth = DEPTH*0.45*base, panned L/C/R by WIDTH. Defaults = v1 (rate 0.9 Hz, mod 0.3, +3 dB, mix 100 %). Output always stereo.
